description: This file is part of the ADOdb library and manages session handling with CLOB support. It includes licensing information, dependencies, and a call to initialize session handling with CLOB.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: A class responsible for session management within the ADOdb library, specifically handling CLOB data.

methods.name: clob
methods.description: Initializes or sets up handling of CLOB (Character Large Object) data within the session management context.
